    • Field Detail

      • Serial

        public final java.lang.String Serial
        Serial number of the card. In numerous cases, the serial number is random. In some other cases, cards have no serial at all. For such cards, the system generates a fictional number.

        public java.util.ArrayList<CompatEnum<Application>> getApplications()

      • authenticate

        public void authenticate(CompatEnum<AuthProcess> authentication,
                         BinData additionalData,
                         int selector)
                  throws General
        Executes an authentication process. In some special cases, additional system information is necessary for computing additionalData. These pieces of information can be requested by the getAuthReferenceData() method.

        authentication - Authentication identifier.

        selector - Selector parameter for certain authentications.
